STEP 4 - Hidden food: No base layer or hidden pile is visible. The plate holds only a few pieces, so no large hidden mass is added.

- Stuffed pastry with filling: about 250 kcal/100 g

Totals: pizza about 180 g (about 480 kcal), pastry about 80 g (about 200 kcal), crumbs about 10 g (about 25 kcal). Total is about 270 g, roughly 700 kcal.
